factual_claims.claim: Funding was strengthened through the first €250 million covered-bond issuance under a €750 million programme, providing longer-term financing and allowing the bank to reduce more expensive term and foreign deposits.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

This was the first tranche of a €750 million covered bond program... This stable long-term funding allowed the bank to begin intentionally reducing the volume of more expensive term and foreign deposits.' Note 17 details the covered bond issuance.

factual_claims.claim: An agreement with the European Investment Bank Group is expected to provide capital relief and enable up to €249 million of new business lending, although it was not yet effective and had no impact on 2025 results.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

The capital relief accompanying the agreement enables the bank to issue new loans...
